iteration_provenance.observed_failure_used_for_v2_design: the unshrunk residual had useful mean direction on some queries but violated both held-fold tail constraints; the primal-dual multipliers remained too small to enforce feasibility

purpose: prospectively test whether independent inner-fold calibration of a bounded candidate residual can preserve exact fallback, simultaneously control target-query and drug-query base-relative tail risk, and transfer utility to an untouched outer development fold

claim_boundary.candidate_joint_mechanism_if_later_struc: label-independent evidence qualification over a frozen cross-fitted DTI base, with target-query and old-drug-query base-relative tail risks jointly controlling a residual step and exact function fallback when no risk-controlled structural increment is available

nested_protocol.outer_scheme: hold each development fold h in {0,1,2} for evaluation only
nested_protocol.inner_scheme: for the two remaining folds a and b, fit component A on a and calibrate its residual step on b; fit component B on b and calibrate its residual step on a
nested_protocol.held_fold_access: the outer held fold is predicted only after each component's step has been fixed on its opposite inner calibration fold
nested_protocol.exact_fallback: if both selected gammas are zero, final logits are copied from the frozen base before sigmoid
nested_protocol.hyperparameter_search: none outside the frozen step grid

candidate_generator.role: deliberately conventional direction generator; not a novelty claim

risk.pair_definition: all positive-negative Cartesian pairs within each target query or drug query in the current boundary
risk.group_regret: mean final pairwise loss minus frozen-base pairwise loss
risk.empirical_cvar: minimum over observed group regrets of eta+mean(relu(regret-eta))/(1-alpha)
risk.candidate_residual_bound: for step gamma, pairwise logistic regret is deterministically bounded in [-4*gamma,4*gamma]

FIXED_GAMMA_0_10.role: fixed shrinkage control motivated by V1 diagnosis but prospectively frozen for V2

EMPIRICAL_NESTED_SAFE_STEP.risk_gate: both empirical CVaR values <=0.01 on the independent inner calibration fold
EMPIRICAL_NESTED_SAFE_STEP.selection: maximize equal-weight mean of micro, target-macro and drug-macro AUPRC; tie-break to smaller gamma

ASYMPTOTIC_LTT_NESTED_SAFE_STEP.risk_gate: EMPIRICAL_NESTED_SAFE_STEP gate plus a Learn-then-Test intersection-union p-value for both axes
ASYMPTOTIC_LTT_NESTED_SAFE_STEP.eta_rule: for each gamma and axis, fix eta to the empirical 80th percentile of group regrets on the component training fold before reading its inner calibration fold
ASYMPTOTIC_LTT_NESTED_SAFE_STEP.calibration_loss: eta+relu(group_regret-eta)/(1-alpha), whose expectation upper-bounds CVaR at the fixed eta
ASYMPTOTIC_LTT_NESTED_SAFE_STEP.axis_p_value: one-sided Student t p-value for H0: expected calibration loss >0.01; zero variance is handled deterministically
ASYMPTOTIC_LTT_NESTED_SAFE_STEP.joint_configuration_p_value: maximum of target and drug p-values as an intersection-union test
ASYMPTOTIC_LTT_NESTED_SAFE_STEP.familywise_control: Bonferroni over the six positive gamma configurations at delta=0.05; gamma=0 is the deterministic fallback
ASYMPTOTIC_LTT_NESTED_SAFE_STEP.guarantee_boundary: asymptotic and conditional on exchangeable query groups; not called distribution-free or exact because group counts are small and target/drug axes overlap
ASYMPTOTIC_LTT_NESTED_SAFE_STEP.utility_filter_and_selection: same as EMPIRICAL_NESTED_SAFE_STEP among LTT-passing configurations

required_outputs: all component training diagnostics and inner calibration rows before outer metrics
selected gamma and selection reason for every outer fold, seed, component and calibration variant
row-level outer OOF probabilities for all variants and five seeds
pooled and per-fold target/drug empirical CVaR and group regret distributions
target-homology and drug-scaffold clustered micro bootstrap
target-query and drug-query grouped macro bootstrap
source, config, script and output hashes

promotion_gates.positive_step_usage: at least one positive component step must be selected in at least 4 of 5 seeds
promotion_gates.seed_consistency: main variant micro AUPRC exceeds BASE in at least 4 of 5 seeds
promotion_gates.micro_cold_axes: target-homology and drug-scaffold clustered-bootstrap 95% lower bounds versus BASE both exceed zero
promotion_gates.target_direction: target-macro point difference is nonnegative and grouped-bootstrap lower bound >=-0.002
promotion_gates.drug_direction: drug-macro grouped-bootstrap lower bound >0 and score exceeds within-drug permutation 95% upper bound
promotion_gates.held_tail_risk: pooled held target and drug empirical CVaR values are each <=0.01
promotion_gates.incremental_safe_calibration_value: main variant is noninferior to FIXED_GAMMA_0_10 and EMPIRICAL_NESTED_SAFE_STEP on all three pooled ranking metrics

hard_stops: abort on any source or input hash mismatch
never use outer held labels in component fitting or step calibration
never overwrite V1 or frontier artifacts
never recover the 480 hard-gate or 24 later pocket-quality exclusions
never relabel an empirical or asymptotic calibration result as a finite-sample structural guarantee
